verdict.rationale: Manufact hosts MCP servers built from your own code. You can deploy from a GitHub repo or a template, or push from the CLI (`deploy`), and each deployment gets a hosted MCP URL. Templates and the local dev CLI suggest the protocol plumbing is scaffolded for you, but the evidence never says so directly, and nothing shows OpenAPI-to-MCP conversion. Missing for 10: any OpenAPI or API-definition import that generates a server, explicit evidence that custom code is wrapped without hand-writing MCP protocol handling, and independent hands-on corroboration.
